summary: Count the occurrences of a chosen value.
documentation: count scans a list and returns how many elements compare equal to the requested value. It does not change the list.
inputs: A list and the value to count.
caution: Equality determines a match. This exercise uses strings so case differences remain significant.
scenarios: Count repeated product codes in a packing list.
Measure how often a status appears in a simple export.
Count a selected label in survey responses.
title: Count the requested part
problem: Input is an object with parts (a list of strings) and target (a string). Return how many parts equal target exactly.
goal: Use list.count() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Call count on value["parts"] with value["target"].
